patch.value:
function predict_sR(PC):
  sR_sum = 0
  for bank_id in 0..7:
    bank_regs = [r for r in 0..64 if r % 8 == bank_id]
    available_regs = [r for r in bank_regs if reg_status_table[r].valid == 1]
    if len(available_regs) == 0:
      continue
    ut_idx0 = hash_UT(PC, 0) % 8
    ut_idx1 = hash_UT(PC, 1) % 8
    ut_idx2 = hash_UT(PC, 2) % 8
    best_reg = -1
    max_usefulness = -1000
    for r in available_regs:
      reg_pos = r // 8
      u = sR_UT[bank_id].UT0[ut_idx0][reg_pos] + sR_UT[bank_id].UT1[ut_idx1][reg_pos] + sR_UT[bank_id].UT2[ut_idx2][reg_pos]
      if u > max_usefulness:
        max_usefulness = u
        best_reg = r
    digest = reg_status_table[best_reg].payload & 0xFFF
    h0 = hash(PC, digest, 0) % 512
    h1 = hash(PC, digest, 1) % 256
    h2 = hash(PC, digest, 2) % 128
    bank_sum = sR_WT[bank_id].WT0[h0] + sR_WT[bank_id].WT1[h1] + sR_WT[bank_id].WT2[h2]
    if max_usefulness > 0:
      scaled_bank_sum = bank_sum * 2.5
    else:
      scaled_bank_sum = 0
    sR_sum += scaled_bank_sum
  return sR_sum
